clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Roetten Stonehammer sends recruits across the sea to meet the Reclaimers in Desolace. At Nijel's Point, Kreldig Ungor offers paid work recovering lost treasures and relics.

Roetten Stonehammer recruits travelers in Ironforge for the Reclaimers. The group seeks profit in forgotten ruins and barren lands across Kalimdor. Desolace is a harsh stretch ruled by warring centaur clans, but the journey may pay well for those willing to make it.

The route runs west through the Stonetalon Mountains and into northern Desolace. Nijel's Point, an Alliance outpost, sits high among the cliffs. Kreldig Ungor welcomes new hands there. The Reclaimers recover heirlooms, magical artifacts, and family treasures lost across the war-torn world. For the right price, Kreldig and his associates retrieve those valuables from the wild.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's work to be done in Desolace, friend. It's an atrocious place, befouled by centaur and other nasties. But if you're looking for a good week's honest work, then head there, meet with Kreldig Ungor, and tell him I sentcha.

You can find him holed up at Nijel's Point--it's a little cozy camp hidden in the mountains of northern Desolace. Just head east if you enter from the Stonetalon Mountains. It's easy to miss, so be on the lookout.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Glad to see the Reclaimers aren't in short supply of work, or adventurers willing to help out.
I'm Kreldig, friend. You've made a smart move helpin' out the Reclaimers. Everyone needs something these days: they've lost a
Family heirloom, a magic item, a loved one. You never can tell. But with the Reclaimers around, there's no reason, for the right price, everyone can't find what they've lost.
